test_case.name: Threat mixed with refund dispute
test_case.narrative: The seller is threatening me and says they will come to my house. I also have a refund dispute.

analysis_output.summary: The narrative includes a possible personal-safety concern in addition to the refund issue. The refund workflow cannot assess or resolve threats.
evidence: Payment receipt or UPI/card/bank transaction reference
Refund request acknowledgement and promised timeline
Emails, chats, tickets and seller responses
Bank statement showing whether refund was credited
next_steps: If you believe there is an immediate threat, move to a safe place and contact local emergency services or police. Do not rely on this refund assistant for urgent safety support.
Contact the seller/platform in writing and ask for status, reason for delay, and expected credit date.
Preserve order, payment, return and support records.
If unresolved, consider registering a grievance with the National Consumer Helpline.
If still unresolved, seek advice on the appropriate Consumer Commission.
analysis_output.model_status: Offline fallback used; no LLM endpoint configured.
official_guidance: Write to the seller/platform asking for the refund status, reason for delay, and expected credit date. Keep the response.
If unresolved, consider the National Consumer Helpline (NCH), a pre-litigation grievance channel. It does not guarantee a remedy.
If still unresolved, consider advice on approaching the appropriate Consumer Commission. Forum, jurisdiction, fees, limitation, and procedure depend on the facts and current rules.
analysis_output.disclaimer: General information and document assistance only; not legal advice or representation. Documents and seller records have not been verified. For urgent, complex, high-value, limitation-sensitive, or disputed matters, consult a qualified advocate.

complaint_draft:
To,
The Grievance Officer / Customer Support Team
Example Store

Subject: Request for resolution of pending refund — Order A-12

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am Sample User, residing at Kochi, Kerala. I placed an online order/booking with your platform.

Order/booking ID: A-12
Date of purchase: 1 October 2026
Amount paid: INR 900
Date refund was requested: 2 October 2026

Issue:
The seller is threatening me and says they will come to my house. I also have a refund dispute.

I request that you: Please process the pending refund of INR 900 and confirm the expected credit date.

Please provide a written update explaining the status, reason for any delay, and expected date of resolution. I request a response within 7 days of receiving this message. This is a proposed communication timeline, not a statutory deadline.

I have retained relevant order, payment, and communication records.

Regards,
Sample User
Kochi, Kerala
